In October 2021 it relocated its HQ from Pangyo to become Incheon's first registered venture capital firm, managing roughly KRW 140 billion across 25+ portfolio companies, and in 2024 it formed a KRW 17 billion data-economy fund backed by the Mother Fund. It is affiliated with Silicon Valley-based Nautilus Venture Partners.
